parameters.content:
## Triage message
Score message with Jev asks five yes/no ("noul") questions about the latest message plus up to 3 earlier patient messages, oldest first: emergency, asks_for_human, complaint, medical_advice, manipulation. Retry On Fail is 2 tries, not the usual 3: triage runs before every reply, and 2 tries with a 3000 ms timeout already add about 7 s. Map Jev answers to scores reads answers.<name>.noul with optional chaining, so a missing or malformed answer becomes undefined instead of throwing; a request failure takes the error branch to Blank scores on Jev failure, which reports scores: null. Both branches feed Decide route (src/nodes/decide-route.ts), which fails open (route 'agent', flags.triage_failed true, notes []) unless every score is a finite number in [0, 1], then applies config.triage.thresholds with >=: manipulation blocks outright; otherwise emergency routes to 'emergency', asks_for_human or complaint to 'handoff', and each set flag appends its note for the agent.
